text: Security is essential in web development because websites often handle sensitive user information. One basic protection is HTTPS, which encrypts data between the browser and the server, so attackers cannot easily read it. Authentication is also important: it checks that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords, tokens, or two-factor methods. Developers must also use input validation to make sure users enter safe and expected data, which helps prevent common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). Finally, understanding common vulnerabilities allows developers to fix weaknesses early. Good security requires careful planning, regular updates, and continuous testing.
